0.original: ...Mmm? What's the matter? Thought you were going off to train?

2.original:
Master Roshi... I have betrayed the Crane spirit...

In its place, I have learned how to wield my martial arts in ways I never imagined before...

Something I owe entirely to your words, Master.

But I am afraid my training has left me at... an impasse.

4.original:
...Yes, Master. Once, I thought martial arts was a tool to dominate others.

But the skills I've learned from you are something entirely different.

There is warmth... and kindness to them.

And I... I'm not sure which view is the correct one to have any longer.

5.original:
Until I figure this out, no matter how strong I get, I will never attain Goku's strength.

And I can certainly forget about ever surpassing him...

6.original: ...Are you familiar with the Divine Crossing?

8.original:
Yes. Once, there was an evil spirit who settled in the northern mountains...

It summoned every kind of disaster to the land, tormenting the people who lived there.

Master Mutaito heard of this one day, and so he traveled to the land alone...

And he used a special technique to contain the evil force.

10.original:
Indeed...

And the polished form of that skill, I trust you already know very well...

It's none other than the Evil Containment Wave!

11.original: Are you saying I'll find the correct path if I visit there?

12.original:
Ho ho ho... That would depend entirely on you, Tien.

They say that Mutaito's pure soul rests in those lands...

A man of your ability would certainly be able to find something of value there.

14.original:
Understood... I'll pay a visit to the Divine Crossing.

I don't know what I'll find there, but I'm ready to test my powers in Mutaito's resting place!

15.original:
Okay... No matter what awaits you in that land, it's the destiny that has been ordained for you.

Don't fight it! Purify your heart and accept whatever comes...

17.original:
Chiaotzu!

This is going to be a dangerous journey. I think it'd be better for you to stay here.

18.original:
I can't leave you alone when you're so troubled, Tien!

I... I want to help you any way I can!

19.original: ......Well... if you're prepared for whatever we'll face there, you can come with me.

23.original:
O seeker of power, unlock my seal...

you shall be blessed with untold powers...

26.original: Tien... do you think this is the spirit that Mutaito fought with and sealed?

28.original: But he said to unlock his seal...

30.original: Welcome, welcome, o seeker of power. What is it that you wish for?

31.original: ...I want power! The power to surpass Goku!!

33.original:
Tien! You can't break that seal!

If you break it, you'll just be the same as any other murderer!

35.original: We have a promise... Let me have my power!

36.original:
Heh heh heh...you fool.

What makes you think I would ever grant my powers to a mere human?

I'll use that kid over there as a vessel... I'll take his body and conquer the world!

40.original: W-why?! Why aren't I hitting with anything?!

41.original: You stupid fool...tricked by his spiritual magic!

43.original: Look at my seal... You've ruined it!

44.original:
...Your seal?!

...M-M-Master Mutaito?! Oh, Master, I'm so sorry!

I was greedy, and now I'm paying dearly for it...

46.original:
This spirit takes advantage of the weakness in people's hearts...

Normally I would punish you for this, but... hmm...

I know. Perhaps I could call it even if you sealed this spirit again...

47.original:
But he just moves too quickly for me, sir!

I could hardly even take him on in combat, much less seal him away...

48.original: Ho ho ho! It appears you have yet to understand the true meaning of your martial arts.

50.original: Indeed... Is there anything in your life you want to protect?

52.original:
Yes.

If martial arts can be used to hurt someone, it can also be used to protect them!

I contained this spirit in order to protect the people that live in this land!

54.original: (Tien... Please don't stray off the path any longer...)

55.original:
Chiaotzu!

That's it!

I've got to protect Chiaotzu... the one who cherishes me like a brother!

56.original:
Ho ho ho.

Well, if you know what must be protected, now you must find the skills that only you possess...

58.original:
Yes... You have three eyes, and your movements are quick and nimble.

With that in hand, perhaps you could read that spirit's next move before it acts...

59.original:
...! You're right!

I could watch him from four different viewpoints... then there won't be any blind spots!

I've gotta try this out! It's all or nothing!

63.original: Do you think you understand what I have told you?

64.original:
...Yes, Master. Martial arts is not for harming people...

It is a tool to protect others, as well.

65.original:
Yes...

I see you are worthy enough now to use the skill I have invented.

67.original: Indeed. I'm sure you're aware of it by now.

68.original: The Evil Containment Wave...? But I couldn't...

69.original:
Hah hah hah! You may use this skill in any way you wish...

I look forward to seeing how you grow, my lad.

74.original:
...!! Tien!

What about you, Tien? Are you okay?!

76.original: Heh heh... I knew you'd come to help me, Tien.

78.original: ...Very interesting. So that's what happened there...

79.original: Do you think you've learned the true meaning of your martial arts, then?

82.original: What I have learned is that there are some things in my life that I absolutely must protect.

84.original: I also think I understand where Goku's true strength lies...

85.original: So have you gotten rid of your doubts?

86.original:
...Yes, Master. I wish to master my skills to protect those I hold dear.

While I do so, I want to continue searching for the true meaning of martial arts.

88.original:
...I don't know if I will or not.

But if I keep doing everything I can to strive for that goal...

I think that'll be what leads me to become truly strong like Goku...

89.original:
You've grown, Tien...

Now, it's time to explore the outside world and train to your heart's content!

91.original:
(Listen up, Goku! I think I've finally taken a step toward your strength.)

(I'm going to be a different man when we meet again!)

96.original: Eeeeee! Oh, wow, I haven't seen either of you in forever!

98.original: So where is everyone? They still aren't here yet?

99.original: Oooh, my my! I'm surrounded by women! What a shock to the ol' ticker!

100.original: Keep your hands off me, you old coot!

101.original: Oof... You could stand to be a bit more polite...

103.original: Um, speaking of which, weren't you together with Yamcha? What happened with him?

105.original: That guy? Oh, he ran off on us practically the moment we arrived at West City.

106.original: He's off on a solo training journey...

107.original: ...and he left me behind, of course.

108.original:
Ho ho ho... Yamcha too, eh? Krillin went off saying the same thing, y'know...

Goku had a major influence on them three years ago, there's no doubt about that.

112.original:
Hey, old man! Glad to see you alive again!

You're all lookin' great, too!

113.original:
So where are Krillin, and Yamcha, and Tien, huh?

They already go off to fight their preliminary matches?

118.original: Huh? Well, who the heck did you think I was?

119.original: Oh, good! The rain's finally letting up a little!

121.original:
What? You can't recognize me just because I've got this on my head?

Here, lemme take it off. See?

123.original: There's something that's bothering me, though... Did all of you guys shrink, or what?

125.original: Oh, yeah... Guess I picked up a few inches, huh?

126.original: Hey, Bulma, your lips are all red. Are you sick or something?

128.original: Now this... this really is a shock to my ol' ticker.

129.original: Hey! We all ran into each other on the way back!

130.original: It is good to see you again, Master Roshi.

132.original:
Oh, he's just surprised to see how much we've changed!

Take a look, Master Roshi! See how much I've grown? Ha ha ha ha!

138.original:
Gokuuuu!! You bum! I've been dying to see you!

I didn't even get a chance to thank you! Sheesh!

141.original: Soon after, the curtain rose on the 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament...

142.original:
Making the most of their grueling training, Goku, Krillin, Yamcha and Tien all joined in...

The group fought with all their might in hopes of nabbing the world championship.

143.original:
After a series of pitched battles...

The tournament's main bracket was filled out with the names of the strongest in the land.

144.original: Among them was Piccolo Jr., the reborn form of King Piccolo...

145.original: Piccolo Jr. was intent on defeating Goku in the tournament and conquering the world.

146.original:
The level of talent in this tournament was unprecedented.

Kami himself joined in to put a stop to Piccolo Jr., but even he was no match for Piccolo Jr.'s might.

147.original: And so the final match arrived, with Goku and Piccolo Jr. making a fateful rendezvous...

148.original:
Who's that new guy? He's a monster!

I'm guessing he's probably a demon, but he's stronger than anything out there.

149.original: I know who he is... That's King Piccolo.

151.original:
Y-you're kidding!!

You completely pulverized Piccolo! That can't be him!

153.original:
W-what?!

So Goku's the mystery man who saved the world from the Demon King? I can't believe it!

154.original:
Kami told me that Piccolo spat out one more egg before dying...

That egg contained every bit of Piccolo's life force...

So the fighter born out of that egg pretty much is Piccolo.

155.original: Even worse... this Piccolo is way, way stronger than the old one!

156.original: I... I never even dreamed this would be King Piccolo. This is going to be bad...

157.original: But didn't you just see Hero get hit by an Evil Containment Wave...?

158.original: Yeah... This guy that looked like Piccolo was sucked out of his body and into that jar.

159.original: That wasn't Piccolo... He was borrowing a human body so he could fight against him.

160.original: It was Kami. He just looks like Piccolo.

162.original:
Piccolo and Kami used to be the same person.

He discarded his evil side to become Kami... and the remainder became Piccolo.

If one of them is ever killed, the other will die as well.

163.original:
Oh... I see... it makes sense.

That explains the Evil Containment Wave. That would banish one of them without killing him.

164.original: That wave sucked Kami into that jar... Is there any way to get him out of there?

165.original: We just need to get the lid open... but Piccolo swallowed the jar whole.

166.original:
W-what're we gonna do...?!

His... his strength is just staggering. Not even Kami could beat him!

167.original:
Y-you're right...

I have to admit, we couldn't take him on even if we all ganged up at once...

168.original: I... I guess Goku's our only hope again. I hate to say it, but that's how it is...

169.original: Yeah... I'll see what I can do.

170.original:
I'm afraid we need you, Goku. Without the Evil Containment Wave, you're our only chance...

I'm sure Piccolo came to face you here in this tournament because he's fearful of your skill.

173.original:
Goku is nothing more than an obstacle to me right now...

A much tougher one than Kami, no doubt. That guy obviously let up on his training.

174.original:
Heh heh heh... I'm gonna take you down for good this time!

The Piccolo you're about to face is nothing like the one you fought three years ago!

175.original: Well, I'm not the same guy I was, either!

176.original:
Heh heh heh. Talk all you want, it won't matter.

Once I erase you, this world will be mine!

A beautiful, demonic world awaits!

178.original:
Heh... Why are you holding back?

Trying to size me up, or what?

180.original: Heh heh heh... Oh, I've got a lot to show you.

181.original: You're in for a world of hurt!

182.original: Heh heh heh... I know you're pretty much as evil as they come...

183.original: But fighting against someone as talented as you is making me so excited!

184.original: Ha ha ha... You won't be giving me that nonsense once I'm done with you!

188.original: Just try to find an opening. C'mon, I dare you.

190.original:
Huff... huff...

Y-you're gonna pay for this! How could I let you chase me to the edge like this?

Prepare to face the full brunt of King Piccolo's final attack!

192.original:
Get away! Get away!

Everyone, you have to get out of here, right now!

193.original:
(I can't believe he has that much Ki left! I've never felt anything so strong!)

(H-he's putting everything he's got into this move!)

195.original: I can take it! I'll show him!

197.original:
Don't be stupid! Why do you have to be so stubborn?!

This isn't even a match anymore! It's life or death!

You've got to come with us! We need to get out of here!

201.original:
Ladies and gentlemen, the moment is here! The final match is about to begin!

Who will be the greatest fighter in the world? Goku, or Piccolo Jr.?

Fighters, you may enter!

202.original:
You won't be away from your friends for long.

Once I kill you, I'll be sure to send the rest of 'em your way, too!

203.original: G-Goku...! You gotta win this! I know you got it in you!

204.original: Maybe, but I've never fought this guy before... I don't have too much confidence.

206.original: Hang in there, Goku! Don't get killed! I don't want to be a widow already!

208.original:
The arena is heating up now, folks!

Both fighters are among the most capable that ever lived! This is going to be one killer match!

209.original:
Pfft. The announcer doesn't know the half of it.

The fate of the whole world is riding on this match...

210.original:
The 23rd World Martial Arts Tournament is almost over!

Who will take the top prize and reign supreme?!

215.original: The final match of the tournament begins... now!!

217.original: You killed King Piccolo... and now he will get his revenge!

218.original: He... he still has some power left!

219.original:
......

Hey! Tien! You have to kill me!

That's the only way he's ever going to die!

221.original:
Do it! Hurry, before it's too late!

I can't kill myself! This is the only way we can save Goku!

It will be fine! You can summon Shenron and wish me back to life later!

228.original: Heh... Guess I managed to hold out...

232.original: He took the full force of that explosion, and he's still in perfect fighting shape!

233.original:
There's no way you can win this...!

I know you used all your remaining Ki force on that blast.

240.original: Hey, uh... referee? He... he's out of the ring, right?

242.original: You know... the match? I... won it, right?

243.original: Oh... oh, right! Yes, it's a ring-out!

244.original:
Goku is the victor!!

Goku is the champion of the World Martial Arts Tournament!!

246.original: Hooraaaaayy!! You did it! You won, Goku!!

248.original: You did it! I can't believe it! That was so awesome!!

250.original: Whew... we're safe. I guess it's over, huh?

255.original: No worries! I've got a Senzu Bean right here!

262.original:
All right!!

I won the World Martial Arts Tournament! Yaaahooooo!!

266.original: What were you thinking, Kami? Why did you do something like that?

267.original:
Ngh...! He... he is still alive!

You have to kill him, Goku! He can't be left alive!

If he lives, history will repeat itself over and over again!

268.original:
Well, if that happens, I'll just beat him again!

If I kill Piccolo, then you're gonna die too!

269.original: I told you, just wish me back to life with Shenron!

270.original: H-he's right, Goku... That's the only way.

271.original: You're not supposed to lie to me like that, Kami.

273.original:
Aren't you the one who made Shenron and the Dragon Balls in the first place?

If you die, won't they just up and disappear or something?

276.original:
I... I should have left my post long ago...

I created the evil Piccolo... His power exceeded that of the gods themselves.

I don't have any right to be where I am right now... I deserve to die.

277.original:
But you're the one who can guide the world back to peace.

If it wasn't for your Dragon Balls, neither Goku nor any of us would be here today.

278.original: A single Dragon Ball kicked off this adventure...and that's all it took to save the world.

279.original: Goku... You've been blessed with a wonderful teacher.

280.original: I sure have! He's kind of a pervert, though!

281.original:
Oh, I... I simply taught him the basics, that's all.

It was you, and Korin, who raised him to be the man he is today.

283.original:
Heh heh heh...

Yes... I'd say that the outfit with the Turtle mark befits you the most.

286.original: Huh? What, isn't one enough for you?

288.original: Here, eat this. You need to get better.

294.original:
If you died right now, you'd take Kami along with you.

Besides, I'm gonna need someone to be my rival.

295.original:
Heh heh heh... That kindness is going to kill you someday. I warned you about that.

I'll give you today's match...

But just you wait. One of these days I'll beat you and conquer the world!

296.original: See? See?! Why didn't you seal him away, huh?!

297.original: Ahhhh ha ha hah! I hope you're looking forward to the day we meet again!

298.original:
(Train hard, Piccolo... I need you to be stronger!)

(And when we meet again... I'm still going to be one step ahead of you!)

299.original: Oh, thank heavens! Thank heavens you're still alive!

300.original:
Agh! W-what're you doing, Chi-Chi?!

Get off of me! Knock it off!

301.original: Ohhh! I almost forgot! You're a newlywed now, Goku!

302.original:
Goku... would you like to become Kami in place of me?

You are more than qualified for the job. The two of you could live in my lookout together...

303.original:
Huh? Me?!

Y-you gotta be kidding me!

I'd die if I had to do that! That's soooo boring!

I'm never gonna take that job! No way, no how!

304.original:
But Goku, you can become the new Kami! You can have my powers!

There's no one else in the world who could possibly succeed me!

309.original: Oh, this isn't the end... If anything, it's the beginning!
